title: OSAC Helm Chart Values
description: Configuration values for Open Sovereign AI Cloud deployment

global.description: Values propagated unchanged into every subchart, shared between the umbrella chart's own templates and its subcharts. Use global.networking as the primary networking configuration API.

clusterDomain.description: OpenShift cluster ingress domain (e.g. apps.mycluster.example.com). Backs the tpl-templated defaults for service.auth.issuerUrl, service.idp.url, and service.vault.keycloakIssuerUrl. Set via --set global.clusterDomain=$(oc get ingresses.config/cluster -o jsonpath='{.spec.domain}'). Leave empty on platforms (e.g. kind) that set those three values explicitly instead.

fulfillment.description: Resolved external fulfillment configuration shared with operator trust sync and tenant-cluster CSI provisioning

endpoint.description: External fulfillment gRPC endpoint including port. When empty, service.externalHostname:443 is used when the operator and fulfillment service are enabled.

fulfillmentTrust.description: Cross-cluster fulfillment trust configuration shared with tenant-cluster workloads

enabled.description: Enable fulfillment trust synchronization for tenant-scoped ClusterOrders when tenant CSI trust support is deployed

tenantNamespace.description: Namespace containing fulfillment trust resources in tenant clusters

services.description: Service tier enablement flags. Controls which tiers are active across all OSAC components. At least one tier must be enabled.

enabled.description: Enable CaaS tier (ClusterOrders, ClusterTemplates, ClusterCatalogItems, ClusterVersions)
Enable VMaaS tier (ComputeInstances, InstanceTypes, Volumes, ConsoleSessions). The shared DiskImages API is enabled when either VMaaS or BMaaS is enabled.
Enable BMaaS tier (BareMetalInstances, BareMetalInstanceTypes). The shared DiskImages API is enabled when either VMaaS or BMaaS is enabled.
Enable MaaS tier

osacDeploymentId.description: Required stable identity for this OSAC/fulfillment-service deployment

cliImage.description: Default OpenShift CLI image used by hook jobs

dbInit.description: Shared PostgreSQL host for the db-init hook

kafka.description: Kafka cluster coordinates for per-instance topic/user creation

enabled.description: Create Strimzi KafkaUser resources against the in-cluster Kafka named by clusterName

replicas.description: Kafka broker replica count (drives topic replication factor)

global.description: Helm-injected global values (passed automatically to subcharts)

fabricDomainInventory.description: Admin-managed map of exact Netris hostnames to BareMetalInstanceType ID strings. Creates osac-fabric-domain-inventory in the operator networking (release) namespace only when nonempty. No credentials or template configuration.

enabled.description: Deploy the OSAC operator

ignition.description: Assisted Service discovery ignition HTTPS trust

trustIngressCA.description: Trust the OpenShift-managed default-ingress-cert CA in addition to system roots

upgradeTimeouts.description: Cluster upgrade deadlines. Each value is a positive Go duration string.

pending.description: Time allowed after acceptance before upgrade progress is observed

controlPlane.description: Time allowed after control-plane progress before completion

nodePoolPerNode.description: Time allowed per accepted NodePool node after progress before completion

aap.description: AAP connection settings for the operator

statusPollInterval.description: Interval for polling AAP job status

tokenSecret.description: Reference to an existing Secret containing the AAP API token

organization.description: AAP organization the operator's job labels are created in (default osac).

serverAddress.description: Fulfillment service gRPC address; leave empty to disable the operator Fulfillment client

credentials.description: Reference to the existing osac-controller Keycloak service-account credentials; osac-infra provisions this for bundled Keycloak, while external Keycloak deployments must provide an equivalent Secret

clientIdKey.description: Key within the Secret containing the OAuth client ID

clientSecretKey.description: Key within the Secret containing the OAuth client secret

tls.description: Verified TLS settings for the operator fulfillment client

caBundle.description: ConfigMap key containing the fulfillment CA bundle

name.description: Name of the ConfigMap containing external fulfillment configuration

optional.description: Allow the ConfigMap to be absent when the operator or fulfillment service is disabled

controllers.description: Enable or disable operator controllers. Service-tier controllers default to global.services.* unless explicitly overridden.

computeInstance.description: Override the VMaaS ComputeInstance controller toggle

clusterOrder.description: Override the CaaS ClusterOrder controller toggle

bareMetalInstance.description: Override the BMaaS BareMetalInstance controller toggle

configSecret.description: Optional Secret with additional operator configuration

optional.description: Allow the Secret to be absent without failing the deployment

remoteClusterKubeconfig.description: File path for the remote VMaaS cluster kubeconfig. Set together with remoteClusterKubeconfigSecretName.

remoteClusterKubeconfigSecretName.description: Secret on the management cluster containing the remote VMaaS cluster kubeconfig.

remoteClusterKubeconfigSecretKey.description: Secret key containing the remote VMaaS cluster kubeconfig.

hubAccess.description: Hub access ClusterRole for the operator subchart

enabled.description: Create hub-access ClusterRole (exported for fulfillment-service to bind)

networkManagers.description: Generic network manager registrations passed through to the operator subchart; registration content is owned by manager teams.

stall.description: Stall detection thresholds for ClusterOrder provisioning stages. Each value is a Go duration string (e.g. 15m, 30m, 1h); the operator marks the cluster stalled when a stage exceeds its threshold.

preparingInfrastructureThreshold.description: Maximum duration allowed for the PreparingInfrastructure stage before the operator marks the cluster as stalled

controlPlaneStartingThreshold.description: Maximum duration allowed for the ControlPlaneStarting stage before the operator marks the cluster as stalled

workersJoiningThreshold.description: Maximum duration allowed for the WorkersJoining stage before the operator marks the cluster as stalled

workersJoiningByInstanceType.description: Per-BareMetalInstanceType overrides for the WorkersJoining stall threshold. Keys are exact instance type names, values are Go duration strings.

certs.description: TLS certificate configuration for the operator

vendorControllers.description: Map provider identifiers to vendor controller gRPC endpoints consumed by the Volume controller. Use 'none' for node-local providers such as LVMS.

global.description: Helm-injected global values (passed automatically to subcharts)

enabled.description: Deploy the fulfillment service

sync.description: Enable full synchronization for all fulfillment controllers

externalHostname.description: Hostname for the external API Route

internalHostname.description: Hostname for the internal API Route

enabled.description: Deploy the fulfillment MCP server

externalHostname.description: DNS hostname advertised by the MCP server; Kind requires mcp.<namespace>.localhost

externalPort.description: Externally reachable TLS port for the MCP server; OpenShift Routes require 443

exchangeClientId.description: Confidential OAuth token exchange client ID; use the MCP resource URL ending in / for Keycloak audience validation

exchangeCredentialsSecret.description: Secret containing client-secret for the MCP token exchange client

resources.description: CPU and memory resources for the MCP server container

variant.description: Deployment variant: openshift renders OpenShift Routes, kind renders Gateway API TLSRoutes, vcluster renders neither (the CI run setup publishes the run's routes in the outer cluster)

enabled.description: Deploy the Kafka-backed event publisher (disable for API-only environments)

topicRetention.description: How long a tenant's event topic keeps records: a negative duration like '-1s' keeps them indefinitely, or a positive one like '168h'. Only applies to topics the publisher creates

name.description: Name of the cert-manager ClusterIssuer or Issuer

configMap.description: ConfigMap name containing the CA bundle

issuerUrl.description: OIDC issuer URL (e.g. Keycloak realm URL)

emergencyServiceAccounts.description: Service accounts that bypass standard authentication

idp.description: Identity provider configuration for user management

credentials.description: Credential volume sources for IdP access

connection.description: Database connection volume sources (secret or configMap references)

log.description: Logging configuration for the fulfillment service

endpoint.description: Vault API endpoint URL. Supports Helm tpl so {{ .Release.Namespace }} expands to the install namespace (e.g. https://openbao.{{ .Release.Namespace }}.svc.cluster.local:8200). Leave empty to disable Vault integration.

namespace.description: Parent namespace path within the Vault-compatible store

kvMountPath.description: KV v2 secret engine mount path within tenant namespaces

lifecycleRole.description: Vault role name for JWT authentication during lifecycle operations

transitMountPath.description: Transit engine mount path within ordinary tenant and system namespaces; must differ from kvMountPath

lifecycleMountPath.description: Auth method mount path in the Vault parent namespace for lifecycle JWT authentication

keycloakClientId.description: Keycloak client identifier for Vault authentication

keycloakIssuerUrl.description: Keycloak OIDC issuer URL for configuring JWT auth in tenant Vault namespaces. Supports Helm tpl -- defaults to a global.clusterDomain-backed external route URL matching Keycloak's actual OIDC issuer on OpenShift. Must match the issuer (iss claim) Keycloak puts in its JWT tokens, or OIDC discovery validation fails.

keycloakAudience.description: Expected audience claim in Keycloak JWTs for Vault JWT auth role configuration

caBundle.description: Trusted CA certificates bundle for TLS connections to the Vault-compatible secret store

configMap.description: ConfigMap name containing trusted CA certificates in PEM format under the key 'bundle.pem'. When empty, the shared CA pool is used.

credentials.description: Volume sources for the Keycloak client secret used for Vault authentication

kafka.description: Kafka connection used by the fulfillment service

connection.description: Kafka connection volume sources (secret or configMap references). Each item maps keys to Kafka properties named brokers, user, and password.

httpCorsAllowedOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins for the fulfillment service HTTP API (subchart default)

debug.description: Enable debug mode for the fulfillment service (subchart default)

global.description: Helm-injected global values (passed automatically to subcharts)

enabled.description: Create AAP instance CR (set false if AAP is managed externally)

noLog.description: Suppress sensitive data in AAP logs

routeTlsTerminationMechanism.description: TLS termination mechanism for AAP routes

imagePullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for AAP pods

enabled.description: Run AAP bootstrap job after install

cliImage.description: OpenShift CLI image used by the bootstrap job's init containers (wait-for-admin-secret, wait-for-aap)

backoffLimit.description: Number of retries for bootstrap job

readinessConsecutiveSuccesses.description: Number of consecutive successful AAP readiness checks required before the bootstrap Job proceeds

manifestSecret.description: Secret name for config-as-code manifest instance group

secret.description: Secret name for config-as-code instance group

eeImage.description: Execution environment and job pod image of every OSAC instance group; with a provider Fabric Manager, the provider's image built on aap.bootstrap.image

projectGitUri.description: Git repository URI for config-as-code project

remoteClusterKubeconfigSecretName.description: Secret name provided to AAP config-as-code for VM operations on a remote cluster.

remoteClusterKubeconfigSecretKey.description: Secret key containing the remote cluster kubeconfig.

eeImagePull.description: Execution environment image pull specification for config-as-code

addonOperatorMaxConcurrentJobs.description: Maximum number of add-on operator jobs allowed to run concurrently

create.description: Create the manifest config-as-code instance group

data.description: Additional data entries for the manifest config-as-code instance group

NETWORK_CLASS.description: Supported values: netris, agentless_net, ci (CUDN CaaS only). Legacy backends (esi, nico) are removed from the standard schema.

NETWORK_STEPS_COLLECTION.description: Supported values: netris.steps, ci.steps, agentless_net.steps. Legacy collections (nico.steps, osac.steps) are removed from the standard schema.

DNS_CLASS.description: Fully-qualified Ansible role name of the DNS driver. dns.route53.dns manages Route 53 records; dns.noop.dns skips external DNS for environments that do not manage DNS records.

DNS_ZONE.description: DNS zone to operate in (defaults to EXTERNAL_ACCESS_BASE_DOMAIN)

NETRIS_RESOURCE_CLASS_MAP.description: JSON mapping of resource classes to Netris server labels

SERVER_SSH_BASTION_HOST.description: SSH bastion host for server access

SERVER_SSH_USER.description: SSH user for direct server access

EXTERNAL_ACCESS_BASE_DOMAIN.description: Base domain for external access DNS records

EXTERNAL_ACCESS_SUPPORTED_BASE_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated list of supported base domains

EXTERNAL_ACCESS_API_INTERNAL_NETWORK.description: Internal network CIDR for API access

HOSTED_CLUSTER_CONTROLLER_AVAILABILITY_P.description: Availability policy for hosted cluster control plane

HOSTED_CLUSTER_INFRASTRUCTURE_AVAILABILI.description: Availability policy for hosted cluster infrastructure

PARKING_VNET_NAME.description: Name of the parking V-Net where idle CaaS agents sit before cluster assignment (effective default: idle-agents-network)

secret.description: Secret values for the cluster-fulfillment instance group

NETRIS_PASSWORD.description: Netris controller password for the CaaS Netris steps

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: AWS access key for Route 53 DNS backend

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: AWS secret key for Route 53 DNS backend

SERVER_SSH_KEY.description: SSH private key for server access

SERVER_SSH_BASTION_KEY.description: SSH private key for bastion access

Keys start with the manager's registration name in upper case, for example NETRIS_CONTROLLER_URL. Required when global.networking.provisioningEnabled is true.

OSAC_TEMPLATE_COLLECTIONS.description: Comma-separated list of Ansible collections containing OSAC templates

configMaps.description: Names of ConfigMaps mounted into the operator pod

aapUrl.description: AAP controller API URL used by the BMF operator for provisioning callbacks

aapInsecureSkipVerify.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for AAP API calls (set to 'true' for self-signed certs)

enableNetworkingProvisioning.description: Enable networking resource provisioning in the BMF operator (set to 'true' or 'false')

aapTokenSecretName.description: Name of the Kubernetes Secret containing the AAP API token

aapTokenSecretKey.description: Key within the AAP token Secret

bcm.description: BCM inventory backend configuration. When enabled, creates osac-inventory-config and osac-management-config Secrets and mounts BCM mTLS credentials.

url.description: BCM head node API endpoint (e.g. https://bcm-head:8081)

key.description: PEM-encoded client private key for BCM mTLS authentication

key.description: Key containing the Secret API CA bundle.

netbox.description: NetBox inventory configuration. bmhNamespace supplies the namespace for Metal3 BMH management and the namespaced BMC Secret Role.

enabled.description: Select NetBox as the BMF inventory backend.

bmhNamespace.description: Namespace containing Metal3 BareMetalHosts and their BMC credential Secrets. Used by Metal3 management and the BMF namespaced Secret Role when NetBox is enabled.

tokenSecretKey.description: Key within the NetBox token Secret containing the API token.

tokenValue.description: NetBox API token stored under tokenSecretKey when the named Secret does not already exist.

caCert.description: Optional PEM CA certificate for the NetBox endpoint, stored in a separate Kubernetes Secret.

allowInsecureHTTP.description: Allow NetBox endpoint URLs using HTTP.

enabled.description: Select Metal3 as the BMF inventory backend.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace where BareMetalHost CRs are located when Metal3 is the inventory backend.

hostClass.description: Host class identifier for Metal3 inventory

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full resource name for the BMF operator (subchart default)

global.description: Helm-injected global values (passed automatically to subcharts)

validation.description: Install preflight switch. When false every preflight check is skipped and recorded as skipped in the report.

enabled.description: Run the install preflight checks

preflight.description: Install preflight settings. Installer and CLI setting: it is not part of the OSAC configuration the Enclave Wizard collects.

mode.description: enforce: blocking findings stop the install before anything is created. report: findings are recorded in the report but never stop the install (use with helm --dry-run=server). strict: warnings stop the install too.

skip.description: Checks to skip, keyed by check id (see files/preflight/catalog.yaml), each with the reason it is safe to skip. The reason is recorded in the report.

skipChecks.description: Check ids to skip without reasons, for automation. Each is reported as skipped with a fixed reason. An id that matches no check fails the install.

hubAccess.description: Hub access SA, RBAC, and create-hub hook: the identity the fulfillment service uses on the local hub, for example to create tenant Kafka topics

enabled.description: Create hub-access resources and register local cluster as hub

clusterVersions.description: Seed ClusterVersion records in the fulfillment-service after install

enabled.description: Run the seed-cluster-versions hook job

diskImage.description: Seed a shared Linux registry DiskImage before this ClusterVersion. Required for default versions; existing named records are retained without updates.

name.description: Name of the shared DiskImage to create and reference

sourceRef.description: OCI disk image artifact URL (oci://registry/repository:tag or @digest), not the OpenShift release image

architecture.description: CPU architectures supported by the disk image

default.description: Mark as the default cluster version; requires a diskImage

lvms.description: Register LVMS as a local StorageBackend + StorageTier in the fulfillment service after install. For CI/development environments only.

enabled.description: Run the register-local-storage hook job when LVMS is deployed

bundledPostgres.description: Bundled PostgreSQL configuration (pass-through for osac-infra shared values)

enabled.description: Enable the CAPI provider
Run database migrations during install/upgrade

image.description: Container image for the database migration job

dbUrlFile.description: Path to the file containing the database connection URL inside the migration container

positiveDuration.description: Positive Go time.Duration (e.g. 500ms, 15m, 1h30m). Zero and negative timeouts are invalid.

globalNetworking.description: Networking installation settings shared by the osac chart and its subcharts. The installer's NetworkClass step creates the NetworkClass from fabricManager, k8sManager and networkClass; none of them, addressPlan included, can change after installation.

provisioningEnabled.description: Run networking jobs through the network managers. Set at installation; the fulfillment service refuses to start when it changes later. With false, VirtualNetworks, Subnets, SecurityGroups, ExternalIPPools and FabricDomains become READY without provider work, and ExternalIPs, ExternalIPAttachments and NATGateways are not offered.

excludedIpv4Cidrs.description: Canonical IPv4 CIDRs used by the provider's infrastructure (for example management, provisioning and node networks). VirtualNetwork and ExternalIPPool CIDRs may not overlap them.

fabricManager.description: Registration name of the provider's Fabric Manager (the name in its registration ConfigMap). Required; there is no default.

k8sManager.description: OSAC Kubernetes Manager. Required when VMaaS is enabled. Fixed at installation.

networkClass.description: NetworkClass values. defaults and eastWestCapabilities cannot change after installation.

defaults.description: Tenant Default Networking values: the default VirtualNetwork and Subnet CIDRs and the default SecurityGroup rules.

virtualNetworkIPv4CIDR.description: Canonical IPv4 CIDR of each tenant's default VirtualNetwork.

subnetIPv4CIDR.description: Canonical IPv4 CIDR of each tenant's default Subnet, inside virtualNetworkIPv4CIDR and within the address plan's prefix limit.

ingressRules.description: Ingress rules of the default SecurityGroup.

egressRules.description: Egress rules of the default SecurityGroup.

eastWestCapabilities.description: East-west capabilities requested from the network managers.

supportsEastWestEthernet.description: Request physical Ethernet east-west connectivity (FabricDomains). The Fabric Manager registration must declare the eastWestEthernet capability.

addressPlan.description: Subnet address plan: shares of each Subnet for the Kubernetes Manager (overlay), the Fabric Manager (fabric) and CaaS ingress reservations (lbVip). Each share is a multiple of 0.0625 from 0 to 1 and the shares sum to 1. Without it the installer derives the plan from the enabled services and k8sManager.

addressShare.description: Share of each Subnet's addresses: a multiple of 0.0625 from 0 to 1.

securityRule.description: SecurityGroup rule. TCP and UDP rules need portFrom and portTo; ICMP and ALL rules have no ports. ICMP rules need the security_group_icmp capability of every network manager; ALL includes ICMP.

ipv4Cidr.description: Canonical IPv4 CIDR of the remote addresses.

managerSettings.description: Settings written verbatim, one key per setting. Keys start with the network manager's registration name in upper case.
